texts.g34: Use the designated bag (burnable waste collection bag). Take it to the burnable waste collection point (可燃物集積所). Collection is twice a week (three times a week in summer, June–September). Waste is also collected on national holidays and festival days.
texts.g37: Use the designated bag (recyclables collection bag). Put cans and bottles in separate bags. Take it to the non-burnable waste collection point (不燃物集積所). Collected once a month.

texts.g41: Put out in the net at the designated collection point (指定集積所). (Designated collection points are the community centers (公民館), etc.) Remove the caps and labels. Dirty or broken ones go out as burnable waste. Collected once every two months.
texts.g44: Put out in the net at the designated collection point (指定集積所). (Designated collection points are the community centers (公民館), etc.) Colored trays are also accepted. Collected once every two months.
texts.g46: Put out in the net at the designated collection point (指定集積所). (Designated collection points are the community centers (公民館), etc.) Products must be less than 50cm on each side and less than 5mm thick. Collected once every two months.
texts.g50: Use the designated bag (non-burnable waste collection bag, 不燃物収集袋). Take it to the non-burnable waste collection point (不燃物集積所). Use separate bags for glass items and metal items. Wrap sharp parts in newspaper or similar (cardboard is not allowed). Collected once every two months.
texts.g51: If it does not fit in the bag, it is oversized waste. Cut curtains, rubber mats, blankets, and the like into 30cm squares. Cut hoses and rubber hoses to about 1m. Cut bamboo to 30cm. Drain kitchen waste, tea leaves, and leftover food thoroughly. Wrap dog and other pet droppings in paper. Garden tree branches may be up to 3cm thick.
texts.g53: If it does not fit in the bag, it is oversized waste. Wrap blades, needles, nails, and kitchen knives in newspaper or thick paper, or stick them into it. Use up spray cans and portable gas canisters. If you cannot use them up, release the gas with a gas-venting cap or similar. Remove dry batteries and put them out as special waste.
texts.g55: Wrap sharp parts in newspaper or similar. Heat-resistant glass must be separated from other glass items and put out by itself. Wash bottles well.
texts.g57: Ceramics, pottery, tiles, concrete blocks, etc. Concrete products containing metal are designated waste (特定ごみ).
texts.g59: Items larger than 150cm × 80cm × 60cm must be handled by a licensed contractor. Some items that fit in a bag can be put out as non-burnable metal items or burnable waste. Do not pack items inside storage cases and the like. Fold carpets to 150cm or less and tie them. Fold futons to 150cm × 80cm × 60cm or less…
texts.g61: Dry-cell batteries (alkaline and manganese), fluorescent lamps and tubes, and mercury thermometers go in the collection boxes at City Hall (市役所) and each liaison office (連絡所). For button batteries and rechargeable batteries, insulate the terminals with tape or similar.
texts.g63: Rinse the inside until clean. Separate the cap according to its material. Liquor stores take back 1-shō bottles and beer bottles.
texts.g65: Do not crush them; wash them well. Lids of canned food go in non-burnable waste (metals).
texts.g67: Rinse until clean. Caps go in burnable waste. Take them to the designated collection point on the collection day for PET bottles and foam trays.

texts.g69: Cooking oil, beverage paper cartons (wash and cut open), single-volume books, tissue boxes (remove the plastic), etc. Newspapers, magazines, cardboard, milk cartons, etc. can also be put out as burnable waste.
texts.g71: For rechargeable batteries, apply tape to the terminals to insulate them. Remove dry-cell batteries and put them out as special waste. Mobile phones, chargers, e-cigarettes, etc. can also be put out as non-burnable waste (metals).
texts.g73: TVs (including OLED, 4K, and 8K), air conditioners, washing machines, clothes dryers, etc. For ceiling-embedded or wall-embedded air conditioners, consult the installer.
texts.g75: Gypsum, slate, fireproof safes, diatomite products, enameled bathtubs, FRP bathtubs, hardened paint, etc. Request a licensed contractor.

texts.i0: Minokamo City (美濃加茂市) was founded on April 1, 1954 (Showa 29), centered on Ota Town (太田町) and Furui Town (古井町) in Kamo District (加茂郡).
texts.i1: The big event held every year is "On Festival MINOKAMO (おん祭MINOKAMO)," which is handmade by the citizens.
texts.i2: There are also the Koyama Kannon Hatsuuma Festival (小山観音初午祭) around March every year, and the festival of Suwa Shrine (諏訪神社) around April every year.
texts.i3: The city flower is the hydrangea, and the city tree is the muku tree.
texts.n.intro: This is an introduction compiled by AI from the town's confirmed answers and national data. It checks whether the numbers and names in the sentences appear in the answers or figures it was based on.
texts.g48: Designated bag (non-burnable waste collection bag). Take it to the non-burnable waste collection point (不燃物集積所). Use a separate bag from glass items. Items that mix plastic and metal, such as home appliances, and chunks of combustible material, such as cutting boards, also go here. Collected once every other month.

texts.m1.wall: It is hard to know where to evacuate and when
texts.m1.why: About 14,520 people (26.4% of the town) live in areas expected to be flooded. Of them, about 3,410 are aged 65 or over (population per 250 m square × hazard map; approximate).

texts.m2.wall: They have no way to get to shops or run errands

gomi.指定袋（可燃物収集袋）。可燃物集積所へ。収集は週2回（夏場6～9月は週3回）。祝: Use the designated bag (burnable waste collection bag). Take it to the burnable waste collection point (可燃物集積所). Collection is twice a week (three times a week in summer, June–September). Waste is also collected on national holidays and festival days.
gomi.指定袋（資源物収集袋）。缶とビンは袋を分ける。不燃物集積所へ。月1回: Use the designated bag (recyclables collection bag). Put cans and bottles in separate bags. Take it to the non-burnable waste collection point (不燃物集積所). Collected once a month.
gomi.指定袋（資源物収集袋）。缶とビンは袋を分ける。キャップは外す。不燃物集積所へ。月: Use the designated bag (recyclables collection bag). Put cans and bottles in separate bags. Remove the caps. Take it to the non-burnable waste collection point (不燃物集積所). Collected once a month.
gomi.指定集積所のネットへ出す（指定集積所は各公民館等）。キャップとラベルは取る。汚れ: Put out in the net at the designated collection point (指定集積所). (Designated collection points are the community centers (公民館), etc.) Remove the caps and labels. Dirty or broken ones go out as burnable waste. Collected once every two months.
gomi.指定集積所のネットへ出す（指定集積所は各公民館等）。色付きのトレイも可。隔月1回: Put out in the net at the designated collection point (指定集積所). (Designated collection points are the community centers (公民館), etc.) Colored trays are also accepted. Collected once every two months.
gomi.指定集積所のネットへ出す（指定集積所は各公民館等）。製品は一辺50cm未満、厚さ: Put out in the net at the designated collection point (指定集積所). (Designated collection points are the community centers (公民館), etc.) Products must be less than 50cm on each side and less than 5mm thick. Collected once every two months.
gomi.指定袋（不燃物収集袋）。不燃物集積所へ。ガラス類とは袋を分ける。家電などプラスチ: Designated bag (non-burnable waste collection bag). Take it to the non-burnable waste collection point (不燃物集積所). Use a separate bag from glass items. Items that mix plastic and metal, such as home appliances, and chunks of combustible material, such as cutting boards, also go here. Collected once every other month.
gomi.指定袋（不燃物収集袋）。不燃物集積所へ。金属類とは袋を分ける。尖った部分は新聞紙: Use the designated bag (non-burnable waste collection bag, 不燃物収集袋). Take it to the non-burnable waste collection point (不燃物集積所). Use separate bags for glass items and metal items. Wrap sharp parts in newspaper or similar (cardboard is not allowed). Collected once every two months.
gomi.袋に入らなければ粗大ごみ。カーテン・ゴムマット・タオルケットなどは30cm四角に: If it does not fit in the bag, it is oversized waste. Cut curtains, rubber mats, blankets, and the like into 30cm squares. Cut hoses and rubber hoses to about 1m. Cut bamboo to 30cm. Drain kitchen waste, tea leaves, and leftover food thoroughly. Wrap dog and other pet droppings in paper. Garden tree branches may be up to 3cm thick.
gomi.袋に入らなければ粗大ごみ。刃物・針・釘・包丁は新聞紙や厚紙に包むか刺す。スプレー: If it does not fit in the bag, it is oversized waste. Wrap blades, needles, nails, and kitchen knives in newspaper or thick paper, or stick them into it. Use up spray cans and portable gas canisters. If you cannot use them up, release the gas with a gas-venting cap or similar. Remove dry batteries and put them out as special waste.
gomi.尖った部分は新聞紙などで包む。耐熱ガラスは他のガラス類と分けて、耐熱ガラスだけで: Wrap sharp parts in newspaper or similar. Heat-resistant glass must be separated from other glass items and put out by itself. Wash bottles well.
gomi.陶磁器、せともの、タイル、コンクリートブロックなど。金属が入ったコンクリート製品: Ceramics, pottery, tiles, concrete blocks, etc. Concrete products containing metal are designated waste (特定ごみ).
gomi.150cm×80cm×60cmを超えるものは許可業者へ依頼。袋に入るものは不燃物: Items larger than 150cm × 80cm × 60cm must be handled by a licensed contractor. Some items that fit in a bag can be put out as non-burnable metal items or burnable waste. Do not pack items inside storage cases and the like. Fold carpets to 150cm or less and tie them. Fold futons to 150cm × 80cm × 60cm or less…
gomi.乾電池（アルカリ・マンガン）、蛍光灯・蛍光管、水銀体温計は、市役所・各連絡所の回: Dry-cell batteries (alkaline and manganese), fluorescent lamps and tubes, and mercury thermometers go in the collection boxes at City Hall (市役所) and each liaison office (連絡所). For button batteries and rechargeable batteries, insulate the terminals with tape or similar.
gomi.中をきれいに洗う。ふたは素材により分別。1升びん・ビールびんは酒屋で引き取り。: Rinse the inside until clean. Separate the cap according to its material. Liquor stores take back 1-shō bottles and beer bottles.
gomi.潰さずによく洗う。缶詰のふたは不燃物金属類。: Do not crush them; wash them well. Lids of canned food go in non-burnable waste (metals).
gomi.きれいに洗う。ふたは可燃物。ペットボトル・発泡トレイの回収日に指定集積所へ。: Rinse until clean. Caps go in burnable waste. Take them to the designated collection point on the collection day for PET bottles and foam trays.
gomi.集団資源回収品: Items for Community Group Resource Collection
gomi.食用油、飲料用紙パック（洗って切り開く）、単行本、ティッシュ箱（ビニールははずす: Cooking oil, beverage paper cartons (wash and cut open), single-volume books, tissue boxes (remove the plastic), etc. Newspapers, magazines, cardboard, milk cartons, etc. can also be put out as burnable waste.
gomi.充電式電池は端子部にテープを貼って絶縁する。乾電池は外して特別ごみへ。携帯電話・: For rechargeable batteries, apply tape to the terminals to insulate them. Remove dry-cell batteries and put them out as special waste. Mobile phones, chargers, e-cigarettes, etc. can also be put out as non-burnable waste (metals).
gomi.テレビ（有機EL・4K・8Kを含む）、エアコン、洗濯機、衣類乾燥機など。天井・壁: TVs (including OLED, 4K, and 8K), air conditioners, washing machines, clothes dryers, etc. For ceiling-embedded or wall-embedded air conditioners, consult the installer.
gomi.石膏、スレート、耐火金庫、珪藻土製品、ホーロー浴槽、FRP浴槽、凝固したペンキな: Gypsum, slate, fireproof safes, diatomite products, enameled bathtubs, FRP bathtubs, hardened paint, etc. Request a licensed contractor.
gomi.ガスボンベ、消火器、バッテリー、タイヤ、灯油、農薬、ピアノ、土、石、医療系廃棄物: Gas cylinders, fire extinguishers, batteries, tires, kerosene, agricultural chemicals, pianos, soil, stones, medical waste, etc. Consult the retailer or a specialist contractor.
gomi.オートバイ、原付バイクは販売店に相談。: For motorcycles and mopeds, consult the retailer.
gomi.PCリサイクルマーク付きのパソコンはメーカーに問い合わせ。: For computers bearing the PC Recycle Mark, contact the manufacturer.
gomi.中をきれいに洗う。すり切り部分ははずして素材により分別する。: Rinse the inside clean. Remove any cut-off parts and sort them by material.
gomi.中をきれいに洗う。ふたは素材により分別する。: Rinse the inside clean. Sort the lids by material.
gomi.ペットボトル・発泡トレイの回収日に指定集積所へ: Take to the designated collection point on the collection day for PET bottles and foam trays.
gomi.発泡スチロール製トレイをきれいに洗う。汚れが取れないものは可燃物。ペットボトル・: Rinse Styrofoam trays clean. Trays whose dirt cannot be removed are combustible waste. Take to the designated collection point on the collection day for PET bottles and foam trays.
